::: {#thm-chebyshev-sample-mean}
#### Chebyshev's inequality for a sample mean

Let $\dsn{X}$ be [IID](independence.qmd#def-iid) random variables
with population mean $\mean$ and finite variance $\varpar > 0$,
and let $\samplemean{X}{n} \eqdef \avgin X_i$.
Then for every $\epsilon > 0$:

$$
\Prf{\abs{\samplemean{X}{n} - \mean} \ge \epsilon} \le \frac{\varpar}{n\epsilon^2}
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-chebyshev-sample-size (a), worked in @sol-chebyshev-sample-size.
It applies @thm-chebyshev to $\samplemean{X}{n}$, whose variance is $\varpar/n$ by @cor-mean-iid-moments.

:::
